_comment: Deterministic workspace state for the admin account, pushed by './tester-env seed'. Theme: a people-analytics workspace on the built-in 'Sample (Employees)' SQLite database. The three saved queries are verified by './tester-env verify' against the sample, so their row counts are stable. Dates are fixed and absolute; no wall-clock values.

saved_queries.name: Headcount by department
saved_queries.description: Current headcount per department from the employee sample
saved_queries.query:
SELECT d.dept_name, COUNT(*) AS headcount
FROM dept_emp de
JOIN department d ON d.dept_no = de.dept_no
WHERE de.to_date = '9999-01-01'
GROUP BY d.dept_name
ORDER BY headcount DESC, d.dept_name;

saved_queries.name: Average salary by title
saved_queries.description: Average current salary per job title
saved_queries.query:
SELECT t.title, COUNT(DISTINCT s.emp_no) AS employees, ROUND(AVG(s.amount), 0) AS avg_salary
FROM salary s
JOIN title t ON t.emp_no = s.emp_no AND t.to_date = '9999-01-01'
WHERE s.to_date = '9999-01-01'
GROUP BY t.title
ORDER BY avg_salary DESC;

saved_queries.name: Top 10 paid employees
saved_queries.description: Highest current salaries with their department, for the pay review
saved_queries.query:
SELECT e.emp_no, e.first_name || ' ' || e.last_name AS employee, d.dept_name, s.amount AS salary
FROM employee e
JOIN salary s ON s.emp_no = e.emp_no AND s.to_date = '9999-01-01'
JOIN dept_emp de ON de.emp_no = e.emp_no AND de.to_date = '9999-01-01'
JOIN department d ON d.dept_no = de.dept_no
ORDER BY s.amount DESC
LIMIT 10;
